source: Values behind the paper (NeurIPS 2026) for Pythia-410M, POS (16 UPOS classes), mean-centred inputs: 3 real probes (seeds 1001-1003) and 3 type-matched control probes (label seeds 42-44) per layer and checkpoint. events: per-layer t^D (selectivity) and t^E (first qualifying peak of [CE]_+) as used for the paper figures.
